newsitem.title: USA: Chad Therapeutics stake held by Kimberlin.
newsitem.headline: Chad Therapeutics stake held by Kimberlin.

text.p: Kimberlin Family Partners LP said Wednesday it holds a 6.56 percent stake in Chad Therapeutics Inc or 645,204 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Kimberlin said its latest transactions include a net 71,500 common shares bought between July 10 and January 3 at prices ranging from $14 to $17.76 per share.

Chad, of Chatsworth, Calif., develops, produces and markets respiratory care devices designed to improve the efficiency of oxygen delivery systems for home health care and hospital treatment of patients.
